audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Sett/Skill/Ornn/Ornn/Sett/Ornn/Ornn — the opposite shape to the mirror on six of seven rows.
audit.why: The mirror (ornn__sett) settled Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Skill, Sett: Ornn's Living Forge resists and 800-range Q own the first levels, the middle stages are a skill fight, level 6 is his ultimate window, and only the late 1v1 belongs to Sett. The 49.69% win rate fits a lane Sett does not simply win.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the mirror's chart as matched full+content pairs, with ratings and the four contradicting why lines moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Sett spike ('start fights Ornn doesn't want') while the content layer already called it Ornn's window.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s at 2500 range: the elemental runs enemies over for damage, a slow and Brittle, and he can recast to charge into it and redirect it. That is the largest single swing in the lane and it is his.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the ultimate, its cooldown and the recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repeated 'wall-knockup' phrasing never said what actually creates the knock-up, and the terrain threat to your retreat was absent.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9s at rank 1) leaves a magma pillar after a delay; Searing Charge (E, 450 range, 14s at rank 1) only knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain — his own pillar counts. Both create terrain, and Sett has no dash, so the pillar also cuts your retreat.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now name the pillar-into-charge mechanic and the Flash-for-the-wall rule.

edits.before: Sett wins Level 1 as Ornn's slow immobile kit can't punish his early Pit Grit trades.
edits.after: Ornn wins Level 1: Volcanic Rupture pokes from 800 and his passive gives free resists.

edits.before: Sett stays ahead at Level 2 with E-Facebreaker and Haymaker cutting his early armor.
edits.after: Ornn stays ahead at Level 2 — Bellows Breath Brittles you before your E is online.

edits.before: Sett dominates Level 3 since he sidesteps Q and out-trades through Brittle.
edits.after: Level 3 is skill: sidestep the Q pillar and your Facebreaker trade lands.

edits.before: Sett keeps the edge at Levels 4-5 with true damage beating Ornn's tank stats.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even — your true damage against his passive-boosted resists.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Ornn on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture reaches 800 and his passive stacks extra resists from every item, so level 1 is his. Farm it out, bank the Grit his poke feeds you, and wait for Facebreaker.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Ornn and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with Volcanic Rupture.
edits.after: Q gives move speed toward Ornn and two empowered punches, but Bellows Breath leaves you Brittle — trade only after that final gout has missed.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Ornn doesn't want. Suplex him into your wave or tower, never into his own minions.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) is his window: the elemental runs you over for a slow and Brittle, and he recasts to redirect it. Do not fight into it.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9s at rank 1): plants the pillar he charges into. Stay off that line.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His E only knocks up on terrain — his own Q pillar counts. Stand clear of both.

edits.before: Ornn wastes Volcanic Rupture — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Searing Charge needs terrain to knock up — deny him the pillar.

edits.before: That is Ornn's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His Q pillar cuts your retreat and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall.

edits.before: Track Ornn's Volcanic Rupture: Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Track Ornn's Volcanic Rupture: it plants a pillar he charges into. When it is down — E-stun + W him.

notes: The mirror flagged that several ornn__sett strings claim Bellows Breath grants a shield and unstoppable. Nothing on the Sett side asserted that, so no such claim was written here either — Riot's text for Bellows Breath is only 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.' Bellows Breath's listed range of 25000 in the kit is a tooltip artifact and was not used. What Brittle actually does numerically (damage amplification, extended CC) is not in Riot's short text, so the page says only that you become Brittle and should trade after it misses. Packet games count (2268) disagrees with the brief's top-level games (2638); the matchup is well above any deferral threshold either way.
